QuestInfo.name: Enemy Mastermind
QuestInfo.0: Nova's traitors act in a very organized way. There might be a dangerous mastermind behind the scenes. Ask #p3000000# to investigate who this could be.
QuestInfo.1: Try to dig up some information about the enemy's mastermind while reclaiming the relic. Find any clues that you can at the enemy base and return to #p3000000#. Try to search deep within the enemy base, as well.
QuestInfo.2: The enemy mastermind was Magnus! Judging by the conversation between Magnus and the enemy commander, Magnus plans to launch an invasion soon.

0.0: The traitor priests of Nova act boldly and deliberately. There must be a powerful mastermind behind the scenes. Can you look into this?

yes.0: While you are out beating down on the Relic thieves, find any clues you can as to the identity of the mastermind. I'm guessing you'll have to go pretty deep to get it.

no.0: I don't think wiping out these troops is going to solve our problems.

1.0: Have you found anything about the enemy leader?

yes.0: Magnus?! We're up against Magnus? With the Protective Shield weakened? Oh, we are in trouble now. Okay, worst-case scenario time.

item.0: There is something. There has to be! Find any evidence you can and bring it back to me. Start at the hidden entrance at #m400010300#.
